items.source: Saudi Gazette – Business
items.source_excerpt: RIYADH — Minister of Investment Fahad Al-Saif announced a 110 percent year-on-year increase in the number of licenses issued to foreign investors in the Kingdom. He also revealed that the number of regional headquarters established by global companies in Saudi Arabia has reached 780, underscoring the accelerating momentum in attracting international investments and further consolidating the Kingdom’s position as a premier destination for global companies and a regional business hub. He made the remarks while speaking via video conference at the BNP Paribas Global Markets Conference in London.
